notes.title: Global Launch of Cubic Crush Streamer Showdown!!
notes.notes: [b]Cubic Crush Streamer Showdown[/b] is now available for download! Take advantage of the launch offer and join the fun. 14 unique rooms, four-dimensional simultaneous gameplay, power-ups, missions, achievements, global ranking, tour mode, and the fun Twitch Mode... Are you ready for the challenge?
